name: NeoFreeBird-app-port
description: A modified Twitter app, with branding reverts, BHTwitter and other QoL modifications.
readme:
# NeoFreeBird The Twitter app that you deserve

A modified Twitter/X app for iOS/iPadOS devices with branding reverts, a new updated BHTwitter, and many other useful features.

     

> [!WARNING] > Please do not create issues regarding sign in or Tweeting.
Twitter/X have added Attestation to prevent the use of third-paty or modified clients. We cannot do anything against this. Please do not create new issues regarding this. | | | | |:-------------------------:|:-------------------------:|:-------------------------:| | | | | | | | | ## Features NeoFreeBird uses a modern app version with various changes such as branding reverts, removal of unnecessary features, along with our own fork of BHTwitter for blocking ads, getting various Twitter Blue features for free and being able to customize Twitter in various ways. Theres tons of new features to try! | | | | |:-------------------------:|:-------------------------:|:-------------------------:| | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9192.png) | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9193.png) | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9194.png) | | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9195.png) | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9196.png) | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9198.png) | | ![](./Branding/screenshots/IMG_9199.png) | | | > [!NOTE] > There are some remains
You may still see some X branding in web based stuff. We try our best to get rid of most of them.

name: wtfroichi.github.io
readme:
# wtfroichi.github.io
Personal portfolio and project showcase for Roi (wtfroichi).

This repo contains a static site that lists public GitHub projects and presents audiovisual + code work with a hacker/neon aesthetic.

What's included:
- `index.html` — main site (hero, about, projects, contact)
- `assets/styles.css` — neon hacker styles
- `assets/projects.json` — embedded snapshot of public repos (falls back to GitHub API)
- `assets/favicon.svg` — simple neon favicon

To update the embedded projects list automatically, fetch the GitHub API and overwrite `assets/projects.json`.
